Efficacy and safety of a four-drug, quarter-dose treatment for hypertension: the QUARTET USA randomized trial. New approaches are needed to lower blood pressure (BP) given persistently low control rates. QUARTET USA sought to evaluate the effect of four-drug, quarter-dose BP lowering combination in patients with hypertension.
